surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites
evidence: The surface reaction mechanism and associated chemistry are discussed in the context of ALD processes using amide precursors and H2O. The text mentions ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites. The presence of bonded carbon and OH species, as well as the desorption of OH and carbonate species after annealing, indicates the formation of intermediate species such as monomethyl aluminum, surface hydroxyls, and formate species.
